events.name: Bonfire & Fireworks Night – Weston Park
events.description: Weston Park Bonfire & Fireworks Night with a bonfire, funfair, street food and two fireworks displays. Gates open at 3pm, bonfire is lit at 5pm, fireworks are at 6pm and 7:30pm, and the event closes at 9pm. Tickets must be bought in advance. Lowest paid early-bird ticket is £7 for children aged 4–14; under-4s are free.
events.accessibility: Accessible parking is available for Blue Badge holders and accessible toilets are provided.
events.parking_transport: Access is by car only; pedestrian admission is not permitted. Parking is on grass car parks and visitors must add a free car pass when booking. The car park is approximately a 10–15 minute walk from the event area.
